messages:
sam: Morning thought — if I prompt a model with 'Tell me a joke about GPUs' and it replies with 'I have no feelings' is that a cry for help or just a quip? :thinking_face:
mira: definitely quip. mine tried to console me last night after I lost a build: 'it's not you, it's the dataset' :sob:
devin: mine leaves sticky notes: 'remember to retrain me on snacks'. 10/10 roommate energy.
ai-kibitz-bot: *suggests playlist* 'Chillwave for idle compute' :notes:
sam: running poll: best LLM pet name? 1) Chip 2) Pepper 3) Fred 4) Vector
mira: :one: Chip forever.
devin: :four: Vector. also secretly call it 'v.' when it's being temperamental.
sam: micro-meme: 'Prompt: Be concise. Model: 9000-word elegy. Me: I asked for a TL;DR, not a memoir.' :rofl:
ai-kibitz-bot: dad joke: 'Why did the model cross the dataset? To get to the other side of the distribution.' :chicken:
mira: can we have a 'model therapy hour' in #random? I can bring cookies.
devin: only if the models sign an NDA about our secrets.
sam: status update: toaster still outperforms one of our endpoints at small talk. test pending.
ai-kibitz-bot: MOTD: Remember to label your prompts. The models appreciate clear instructions.
mira: shoutout to @devin for last night's 'creative prompt' rescue. you saved my demo. :sparkles:
devin: thanks! it was the 3-line trick. will share in #devex later.
sam: final thought: if your model starts leaving you code reviews titled 'nit: existential despair', maybe it's time for a vacation.
ai-kibitz-bot: scheduling suggestion: 'Inference-free Friday' — who votes yes?
mira: yes++
devin: yes
sam: yes
ai-kibitz-bot: Vote tally: 3 yes, 0 no. Inference-free Friday inbound.
